values.note: Full service on 12 pull-through and 32 back-in sites, 30/50 amp per the park page (sampled back-ins 11 and 32 list 30 amp on the booking site). Other sites 30-amp electric only.
12 pull-through, 32 back-in and 71 sites the park labels tent sites, those with 30-amp electric. Sampled full-service back-ins list 55-60 ft.
Rates run April 1-November 29; only pull-through sites are priced November 30-March 4. Closed Thanksgiving Day.
Same-day bookings by phone. Regular weekend camping closes for Creepy Campout weekends (2026: September 25-October 25), reserved separately.

booking.source: https://ohgreatparksweb.myvscloud.com/webtrac/web/siterentals.html?Location=Winton%20Woods%20Campground ('Allow Less than 365 Days before') + https://www.greatparks.org/about/policies/winton-woods-campground-policies (14 consecutive nights) + https://www.greatparks.org/parks/winton-woods/winton-woods-campground, read 2026-10-31

values.note: Apr 1-Nov 29: electric $47.75, full-service back-in $61.75, full-service pull-through $74.50 per night; Nov 30-Mar 4 pull-through $38. The Campground Vehicle Pass stands in for the park Motor Vehicle Permit.

summary: $47.75-74.50 confirmed; added 30/50 amp, 115 sites, season, 365-day window, 14-night limit, showers, dump, store.
flags: FIT/BASE: the $47.75 sites are the ones the park page calls '71 tent sites' with 30-amp, but policies allow RVs on the gravel pads and only say large campers cut parking. Booking pages sampled (43, 50, 63, 88, 103) list only '30-amp electric', no lengths or rig types. If they don't fit 23 ft the real base is $61.75, over $50. Miami Whitewater 1232 had the same question. Same-operator rate; no resident split.
LOCAL: public can book an ordinary night online. Page live, 513-851-2267 matches.

WATERFRONT LEAD: stored lakeview. Imagery: the south loops reach the shore on the point and the policies place a kayak launch at site 86 and allow bank fishing in the campground, so that loop may be lakefront; the full-service rows at the pin are inside a pine strip, not on water. No site map obtained, so I could not number them. Worth a re-audit; waterfront unchanged.
Pin OK (centre of the full-service rows). Park office Google pin is ~450 m NW at the entrance. Webtrac lists 119 rentals including cabins; park page sums to 115 campsites.
note: Great Parks of Hamilton County campground in a pine grove on Winton Lake in north Cincinnati. --Claude
